research_question: Does fixed Ineichen clear-sky plus learned additive residual improve paired Folsom GHI forecasts, especially ramps?
decision_rule: Report all paired E1/E2 outcomes. Do not use test results to select a condition.

decision_thresholds.reference: Zhang et al., Solar Energy 316 (2026) 114864 and the frozen local Folsom protocol
decision_thresholds.applicability: Ramp grouping and event detection only
decision_thresholds.derivation: Directly reuse the published and prior-project operational threshold; it is not a success gate.

seed_policy.rationale: One predeclared seed for the exploratory input and target-parameterization comparison.

resource_plan.estimate_basis: Existing two-frame CNN+TCN runs on the same P100 plus six-frame input and three full years; cache preprocessing is included.
